company_name: United Continental Holdings, Inc. (fka Continental Airlines, Inc.)

fuel_consumption.source_quote: Projections based on estimated consumption of four billion gallons and a price of $2.96 per gallon, excluding taxes and other delivery costs. Impact of $1 increase in price per barrel: $94 million.

instrument_type_details.notes: UAL consolidated at Dec 31, 2013: 24% of 2014 fuel (951 million gallons) and 8% of 2015 (309 million gallons) hedged. Instruments include fixed price swaps, call options, collars, three-ways, and four-way collars. Commodities: diesel fuel, crude oil, aircraft fuel. Total fair value $104 million asset.

warnings: Filing is United Continental Holdings (UAL); Continental is a wholly-owned subsidiary. No separate Continental segment hedge data disclosed from FY2013 onward.
